reviews.author: amy
reviews.text: Gabe is personable, attentive and a good communicator. He and his team did an excellent job, even beyond what we’d contracted. He was on time and left the area probably cleaner than before they started. The price was reasonable & in line with other reputable tree companies I’ve dealt with. I would definitely use him again.

reviews.author: Ronald Bacelo
reviews.text: I was in a bind and needed some trees cleared to make room for a building that was arriving tomorrow. Gabriel and his crew not only handled it the same day, but quoted me the best price. Top notch company. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: joan danley
reviews.text: GAPA Tree Service was excellent. Gabriel, the owner, took a personal interest and worked alongside his crew at all times. Whole crew was friendly and diligent. They trimmed the branches off my many large trees as needed and cleaned up well before they left. I highly recommend GaPa Tree Service

reviews.author: Bryni Miksch
reviews.text: HIGHLY RECOMMENDED Gabe and his crew did an excellent job. Not only removed the tree that fell, they also trimmed up and thinned out small trees that had a lot of over growth. The property was also cleaned up after the job was completed. I have already told Gabe to give me an estimate on bush and tree trimming for next month.

reviews.author: Alan
reviews.text: I had Gabe cut down some tree branches for me. Gabe did exactly what I needed, was great with communicating, price was very fair and he cleaned everything before he let. Was very happy with Gabe and his work. Will definitely use him again.

reviews.author: Margaret Thompson
reviews.text: Gabe and his crew did a fantastic job on our trees. The trees look great, price was reasonable, and they cleaned up all of the mess. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Lynn Smith
reviews.text: Gabriel did exactly what he said would do and when he said he would do it. The price was very fair and the service was excellent. I will definitely use GA/PA Tree Care again.

reviews.author: Ivy Jackson
reviews.text: I’m very happy with the job done by Ga/PaTree Care! Gabe was very professional and punctual. He did exactly what I requested and if you are looking to have trees removed highly recommend his company!

reviews.author: John Gray
reviews.text: Gabriel was great to work with. He and his crew did an excellent job. I will definately call him first for any tree work I need in the future!! 5 Star Plus review !!!!

reviews.author: William Modderno
reviews.text: Gabe comes every year to prune our Japanese maple and does the best job. I text home and he is there the next day. 100% hire home for sure!!!

reviews.author: Tammy Thompson
reviews.text: They did a fantastic job cutting down a tree and doing trimming. Very professional and personable. Communication via text was excellent.

reviews.author: Anna Selby
reviews.text: Very reasonable price, work was done quickly and all debris was removed. Highly recommend to anyone needing tree work done.
